content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raebareli Faculty Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: Here is a quick summary of the AIIMS Raebareli Faculty Recruitment 2026 for candidates who want the key facts at a glance: Register for Job Alerts AIIMS Raebareli is an apex healthcare institute set up by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojna (PMSSY), with the objective of correcting regional imbalances in tertiary healthcare and achieving self-sufficiency in graduate and postgraduate medical education. The Executive Director, AIIMS Raebareli, invites applications for the above Faculty posts through this recruitment drive.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raebareli Faculty Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: AIIMS Raebareli has announced a total of 91 vacancies for Faculty posts across 35 departments including Anatomy, Cardiology, General Medicine, General Surgery, Neurology, Neurosurgery, Radiology, Orthopaedics, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, and others. The post-wise and category-wise vacancy break-up is as follows: The department-wise distribution of these 91 vacancies across all 35 departments (such as Anaesthesia & Critical Care, Biochemistry, Cardiology, Nephrology, Neurosurgery, Radiology and others) is provided in detail in the official notification. AIIMS Raebareli has clarified that the above vacancies are provisional and subject to variation, and the Institute reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies, including reserved category vacancies, as per Government of India rules.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raebareli Faculty Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: For all four posts, candidates must hold a medical qualification recognised under the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (First or Second Schedule, or Part II of the Third Schedule), along with a recognised postgraduate qualification such as MD/MS, or an equivalent recognised qualification in the concerned discipline. For super-specialty subjects, candidates additionally require an M.Ch. (for surgical super-specialties) or D.M. (for medical super-specialties) or an equivalent recognised qualification. Candidates holding a DNB qualification in broad or super specialties must submit documentary evidence of DNB equivalence with MD/MS/DM/MCh as per the NMC notification dated 14.02.2022, as specified in the official notification. Experience of Dental, Nursing, and Physiotherapy colleges is not counted for any post. In the Department of Trauma & Emergency Medicine, candidates with MD/MCh in Emergency Medicine or Trauma Surgery, or MD/MS in General Medicine, Anesthesia, Respiratory Medicine, General Surgery, or Orthopedics may apply.

faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Raebareli Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an official recruitment drive by All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Raebareli to fill 91 Group A Faculty posts of Professor, Additional Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor on Direct Recruitment, Deputation, and Contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Raebareli Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 91 vacancies are available: 21 for Professor, 20 for Additional Professor, 23 for Associate Professor, and 27 for Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Raebareli Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 10 September 2026, till 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for AIIMS Raebareli Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a recognised medical qualification under the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956, along with a postgraduate qualification such as MD/MS (or M.Ch./D.M. for super-specialty subjects), plus the post-specific teaching/research experience described above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AIIMS Raebareli Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 58 years for Professor and Additional Professor, and 50 years for Associate Professor and Assistant Professor, as on the closing date, with age relaxation applicable for SC/ST, OBC, PwBD, and Government servant candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for AIIMS Raebareli Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 2,360/- for General/OBC/EWS candidates and Rs. 1,180/- for SC/ST candidates. PwBD candidates, and those applying on Deputation or Contract basis, are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for AIIMS Raebareli Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official AIIMS Raebareli website, www.aiimsrbl.edu.in, before the closing date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for AIIMS Raebareli Faculty posts?
faq.answer: On Direct Recruitment/Deputation basis, pay ranges from Level-12 (Assistant Professor) to Level-14-A (Professor) under the 7th CPC, plus allowances. On Contract basis, remuneration ranges from Rs. 1,42,506/- (Assistant Professor) to Rs. 2,20,000/- (Professor) per month.
